name: C# BookStore Codespace Environment
postCreateCommand: docker compose up -d && echo 'Waiting for SQL Server to warm up...' && sleep 15 && dotnet tool restore || dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef && cd BookStore.Presentation && dotnet ef database update && docker exec -i bookstore-test-db /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P 'SecretPassword123!' -C -i /opt/mssql-scripts/init.sql
